title: Two-stage restriction weight over a fiber
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\delta_1,\\delta_2\\in\\mathbb R$, and fix a coordinate restriction assignment on $n$ coordinates. Sum the two-stage weights over all pairs of restriction assignments whose coordinatewise composition is the fixed assignment. This sum equals the weight of the fixed assignment with parameter $\\delta_1\\delta_2$.
